rules.title: Prefer indexed evidence
rules.description: Answers should prioritize evidence from the loaded project index.

rules.title: Prefer runtime evidence when available
rules.description: When runtime traces exist, use them to support real execution-path claims.

rules.title: Do not overstate certainty
rules.description: If evidence is incomplete, explicitly present uncertainty.

rules.title: No write actions by default
rules.description: The reasoner should remain read-oriented unless explicitly upgraded.

notes: Minimal starter governance state for Project Reasoner V10.
